definitions.full: H1335. bether [ בֶּ֫תֶר ] noun masculine Gen 15:10 part, piece . 1 בִּתְרוֺ Gen 15:10 ; plural suffix בְּתָרָיו Jer 34:18 , הָעֵגֶל בִּתְרֵי 34:19 ; always of halves of animals cut in two in making covenants. 2 בָּ֑תֶר הָרֵי Song 2:17 mountains of cutting , i.e. cleft mountains ᵐ5 Thes and others; or of separation (between us) Ew and others; according to We Prol. 415, Eng. Tr. 391 ׳ב = malobathron . — Bether as proper name AV RV.

occurrences.englishText: He brought him all these, and divided them in the middle, and laid each half opposite the other; but he didn’t divide the birds.
I will give the men who have transgressed my covenant, who have not performed the words of the covenant which they made before me, when they cut the calf in two and passed between its parts:
the princes of Judah, the princes of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, the priests, and all the people of the land, who passed between the parts of the calf;
